title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5.1, section 12 (Chehalis Forest Service Road)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Chehalis Forest Service Road
12 That portion of M.U. 2-19 being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of Chehalis Forest Service Road from the junction with the Statlu Forest Service Road to the northern boundary of the area described in section 33 of Schedule 5. [am. B.C. Reg. 115/2018, App. 1, s. 8.]
